commitResults.messageTitle: fix: pin docker-compose images to release tag to force container recreation
commitResults.messageBody:
Using :latest caused docker compose up -d to skip recreation when the
underlying image changed but the tag name stayed the same. Now IMAGE_TAG
is injected from github.ref_name into .deploy.env on each CD run, and
compose references ${IMAGE_TAG:-latest} so containers are always recreated
on deploy.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: fix: use Docker DNS resolver in nginx to prevent stale upstream IPs
commitResults.messageBody:
When docker compose up -d recreates api/app containers, they get new
IPs but nginx (not restarted) keeps its startup-cached IPs. Docker can
reassign those IPs to different containers, causing / to route to the
API and return 404.

Fix: use Docker's embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) with a 10s TTL and proxy_pass
variables so nginx re-resolves upstream addresses after container restarts,
without requiring docker compose down.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
